prompt: High three-quarter aerial view looking down at about 40 degrees, near-isometric as in a tactics game painted as fine concept art, showing the whole ship alongside the terminal and quay. An ocean liner berthed at a grand Streamline Moderne liner terminal in a retro-future harbour: a cream limestone terminal hall with a fluted harbour tower crowned by a gold starburst, enclosed boarding gangways on lattice gantries reaching the ship's side, bollards and capstans on the quay. The ship is about 100 m long. Behind, the harbour city rises: a 250 m stepped cream-and-gold flagship tower crowned by a giant chrome atom, rival spires with starburst and saucer crowns, a coral monorail on slim pylons. The ship is a 1930s streamliner taken to the space age, like the Normandie crossed with a rocket: a sleek teardrop hull, a raked bow, one huge raked teardrop funnel with chrome speed lines, rounded wraparound decks stepping back like a wedding cake, porthole bands, a long horizontal teal speed stripe along the hull. Optimistic retro-future atomic-age metropolis, the 1950s imagining the year 2000: Streamline Moderne, Art Deco and Googie on a heroic scale. Cream limestone and white enamel, seafoam-teal faience speed bands, coral-red fins and ribbons, brushed gold and chrome crowns, pastel peach and mint accents, rounded streamline corners, porthole windows, no glass curtain walls. Warm low late-afternoon sun, long soft shadows, warm cream haze on the far towers, soft blue sky. Clean, grand, prosperous civic city; no grime, no text, no signage lettering. Cinematic painted concept art with photographic material realism.
